intro: 'Welcome to Azeroth' is an introductory quest that sends a traveler from Thunder Bluff to Orgrimmar on behalf of the Windshapers. Guided by the spiritual ties of the Earthen Ring, the emissary meets with Warchief Thrall to forge bonds of survival and alliance with the Horde.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Its a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.
The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, friend.
